proposed_comments.title: Keep file-backed SVG reads off the synchronous icon-preparation path
proposed_comments.body:
### Keep file-backed SVG reads off the synchronous icon-preparation path

**Severity:** `high`

The new file-backed SVG protocol can perform disk I/O while preparing command icons. That path is exercised during UI population, so slow, remote, or unavailable files can block icon creation and make CmdPal feel hung. Please move file reads to an asynchronous, cancellable path before the icon is needed, preserve a safe fallback when loading fails, and add focused coverage for slow or missing file-backed SVG input.
proposed_comments.out_of_diff_reason: The required change spans the protocol loader, icon preparation flow, and tests; no single current RIGHT-side diff range can safely express the coordinated asynchronous I/O change.

proposed_comments.title: Bound file and inline SVG input size
proposed_comments.body:
### Bound file and inline SVG input size

**Severity:** `high`

Both file-backed and inline SVG payloads need an explicit size limit before parsing. Without a cap, a command provider or file path can hand CmdPal very large SVG text and force excessive memory allocation or parsing work on icon load. Please reject or fall back for oversized SVG input before decoding/parsing it, and add regression coverage for both inline and file-backed oversized payloads.
proposed_comments.out_of_diff_reason: The size guard must be applied consistently to both file-backed and inline SVG protocols plus tests, so it is not safe as one localized apply-ready suggestion.
proposed_comments.outOfDiffReason: The size guard must be applied consistently to both file-backed and inline SVG protocols plus tests, so it is not safe as one localized apply-ready suggestion.

proposed_comments.title: Handle BOM-less and long XML encoding declarations robustly
proposed_comments.body:
### Handle BOM-less and long XML encoding declarations robustly

**Severity:** `medium`

The file reader should not assume the encoding declaration is always short or BOM-backed. BOM-less UTF-16/UTF-32 SVG files and XML declarations beyond the fast probe can be decoded incorrectly, causing valid icons to fail or render as corrupted text. Please detect these encodings robustly, fall back safely when the declaration cannot be trusted, and add regression coverage for BOM-less UTF-16/UTF-32 and long XML declarations.
proposed_comments.out_of_diff_reason: The encoding fix requires coordinated reader logic and regression tests outside a single safe current diff hunk.
proposed_comments.outOfDiffReason: The encoding fix requires coordinated reader logic and regression tests outside a single safe current diff hunk.
